              type: boolean

                telephone; otherwise false. A declared household member (created with

              type: boolean

            - MS

          title: Address
          description: >-

            compatibility (the flat address form). On output it is the composed,
            normalized address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space
            and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255

        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-

            over the flat 'address' input when present (non-blank). Normalized on
            create (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street-type
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Normalized on create like addressLine1 and, when present, appended to
            the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'

          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-

            removing every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits
            afterwards; the stored and returned value is that 10-digit string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-

            syntactically valid address. The stored and returned value is normalized
            to lower case.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'

            be four digits and, when the owner's city has a known region (Sydney->NSW,

          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'

          title: Registration date

          title: Shares household

            possible duplicate. Optional; defaults to false. Write-only: it
            influences creation only and is never returned.

              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A generated customer code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters
                of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than
                the number of owners already in that city at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-

                the last two digits of the fiscal year that the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate falls in (matching the YY of fiscalYear).
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M27'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year that the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate falls
                in, formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by
                the last two digits of the calendar year it ends in (e.g. 1 July 2026 to
                30 June 2027 is 'FY27').

              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-

                owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier for the owner's household, computed as the
                first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of
                '<normalizedLastName>|<postcode>'. Owners with the same last name and
                postcode share the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared the same first name and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was
                created, i.e. excluding this owner itself.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity key: the lower-case hex SHA-256 digest
                of '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>'. All
                duplicate detection is expressed through this single key: a create is
                rejected with 409 only when a new owner's whole identity key exactly
                matches an existing owner's.
              type: string
              example: '3b7f0c2e1a9d4f5e6b8c0a1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, fixed at creation: starting at 0,
                add 2 when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2
                for a household of 3 or more, and add 3 for a tenure of one or more
                elapsed fiscal years.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level from 1 to 4, derived from
                membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                using the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when
                the region has no mapping.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                registration day at the moment this owner was created; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching
                the hard capacity limit of 50) at the moment this owner was created; otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, although not a hard (identity-key) duplicate, shares
                an existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a different
                telephone; otherwise false. A declared household member (created with
                'sharesHousehold') is never flagged, as it is an intentional co-resident
                rather than a suspected duplicate.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a soft match of (same last name

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate computed against the

              type: string
              enum:

              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:

              readOnly: true
